messages:
jun (Eng-Platform): Heads-up: customers reporting surprising bill lines where requests that originated from v2 SDKs show up billed to v1 routes. I traced it to some path-rewrite proxies dropping X-Client-Version and us attributing purely by final path.

maya (Console): Ugh. Console is currently binary on attribution and the route rows show totals only. Customers are confused when the route they requested isn't where the charge landed. We should add a small inline credibility pill next to totals that communicates attribution trust.

arpit (Billing): We need to be careful here. Billing has to be defensible. Two quick safety constraints: (1) only trust header-based attribution when we can cryptographically bind the header (signed token), (2) maintain a reconciliation window so customers can dispute.

jun (Eng-Platform): Implementation suggestion: add a telemetry field attrib_cred with enum values [high, medium, low, unknown]. Determination logic: signed header -> high, unsigned but present + UA regex match -> medium, header missing but UA match -> low, nothing -> unknown. We emit this as part of route_events.

maya (Console): For UX, display a tiny pill with color: green=high, amber=medium/low, gray=unknown. Hover shows breakdown: counts by cred for the route and a link to a diagnostics panel with sampled request IDs. Also add a CTA 'Pause auto-charges' for enterprise tenants to toggle conservative billing while we investigate.

arpit (Billing): The "Pause auto-charges" is a big gearbox for finance. Legal/neha will want language around credits. Also need an alert when medium+low fraction spikes above baseline for a tenant.

neha (Legal): We'll draft the dispute/credit policy but need product to sign off exact UX wording. We prefer conservative language: "Under investigation - billing provisional" rather than 'paused'.

jun (Eng-Platform): Technical notes: we should preserve X-Client-* headers in edge rewrites (PR incoming). Also add a small UA-pattern catalog (conservative) to avoid false positives. We should sample 0.5% of full headers and store only hashed sensitive fields for 7 days.

maya (Console): I'll wire the pill behind a feature flag and add the diagnostics panel. Panel items: recent sampled request_ids, attrib_cred rates, and suggested remediation steps (check proxy conf, allow X-Client-* headers, rotate SDK token). Keep text short to avoid scaring customers.

arpit (Billing): Operational plan: default billing stays path-based. For tenants that opt into conservative mode (enterprise only), we'll temporarily hold uncertain charges in a pending bucket for up to 7 days, then reconcile. Finance ops will issue investigation credits if needed. Need a daily reconciliation job that computes delta and flags >$X anomalies.

jun (Eng-Platform): Rollout plan: 
1) telemetry + attrib_cred enum in logs (canary internal) -> 48h
2) edge header-preserve PR to staging -> e2e matrix including unsigned header, signed header, UA-only clients -> 72h
3) console pill behind flag (5% tenant canary) + diagnostics panel -> 24h
4) opt-in conservative billing beta for enterprise tenants only -> monitor 7 days

ops-bot: feature-flag console/attrib-pill toggled for 5% by jun at 1795550025

maya (Console): Microcopy proposal for the pill hover: "Attribution credibility — green (signed client header), amber (client header present but unverified or inferred from user-agent), gray (no evidence). Click for details and remediation." Keeping it concrete and non-alarmist.

arpit (Billing): Alerts: grafana rule if (medium+low)/total > 0.01 AND tenant volume > 10rpm -> create incident and page billing-oncall. Also alert if claimed_v2_percentage jumps > 2x baseline.

neha (Legal): I'll review microcopy and the finance flows. One request: add an explicit "dispute charge" button in diagnostics that creates a ticket and attaches sampled traces. We'll need trace access logging for compliance.

jun (Eng-Platform): OK owners: jun (edge fixes + telemetry), maya (console pill + diagnostics + KB snippet), arpit (billing alerts + reconciliation job), neha (legal copy + dispute flow). Timeline: telemetry first sprint, console pill + sampling next week. Post quick status updates here.

maya (Console): I'll open PRs today and ping reviewers. Keeping UX conservative — no auto-charges by default.

jun (Eng-Platform): Thanks. We'll keep path-based billing until the canary shows signed-header attribution is stable. If anyone hears from customers about sudden invoices, loop in arpit and neha immediately.
